note: Declared before the context engine was run. All numbers marked PROVISIONAL have no data basis and are open decisions.
min_internal_pool_note: PROVISIONAL. Pools below this return no rows (POOL_TOO_SMALL).
min_train_players_for_fit_note: PROVISIONAL. A context with fewer TRAIN players with pressure balls is CONTEXT_NOT_ESTIMABLE and has no scores; the parent cell's variance is never borrowed.
tau2_floor_note: k_for applies the Phase 4 floor behaviour; rows from floor-hit contexts carry fit_floor_hit=true.
low_data_weight_note: Result-level LOW_DATA_WEIGHT_CONTEXT is reported when the median shrinkage weight of the pool is below this value.

disabled.strict_uncapped: No authoritative player_id-keyed source of international status is loaded (see STRICT_UNCAPPED_DISABLED).
disabled.wickets_remaining_bands: Not supported in v1: the stored context rows carry phase and situation only; the fragments would be smaller than the observed phase fragments.
disabled.all_rounder_role: Not a role: a player appears in the batter list and the bowler list independently, each from actual participation.
